mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, industrial production falling below its 6-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as profit growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 6-month MA during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 12-month average indicates sustained consumer strength, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in payrolls (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust labor market and manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both PAYEMS and INDPRO grow by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom, housing starts (HOUST) falling below its 3-month moving average signals real estate sector weakness, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 3-month moving average during housing market booms.
